title: Nixon-Haldeman Smoking Gun tape

tellings.quote: whole Smoking Gun when you look at the Smoking Gun conversation on the 21st of June that with halman uh in Nixon on the tapes that uh that halderman comes into the office and says uh Mr President I think we've got a problem here

plain: A 1972 recording from President Richard Nixon's White House, known as the Smoking Gun tape because it caught the cover-up of the Watergate break-in on tape, has Nixon's chief of staff H.R. Haldeman walk in and say, as the lawyer and investigator Dan Sheehan quotes it, "Mr President, I think we've got a problem here." Sheehan, summarising the tape without naming where he got his reading, places the conversation on 21 June and ties it to figures including the intelligence chief Richard Helms. He uses it to show how the people at the top handled the scandal behind closed doors.
